source.task_definition: Task.evaluation_criteria.actions is a reference trajectory unless ACTION appears in reward_basis.

companyPersona.persona: Existing industrial manufacturer/distributor inferred from the company’s own A1–E1/S01 workflow and native fixtures; this audit does not add another company or industry.

facts: Northstar Components supplier and Northstar Industrial Systems customer
existing A1–E1 and S01 scenario contracts for purchasing, logistics, finance, sales and internal workflow
existing workplace, ERPNext, supplier/customer, manufacturing and finance scope

summary.fit_decision_note: Original benchmark role fit, possible company-adapted external workflows, and implementation/source integrity are separate. No upstream task rows or criteria are reclassified as passed or suppressed.

airline.reason: The unchanged source tasks operate airline reservation, flight inventory and passenger-service state. The current company can have external airline interactions, but that does not make it an airline or make these original provider-side tasks directly runnable here.

channel_source.domain_evidence: Phone/airline service policy; tasks_voice.json contains 50 voice scenario configurations and is not an additional task set.

airline.implementation_status: The unchanged airline-provider task environment is not implemented in the current-company deployment. External company travel workflows would need their own company-side integration and task definitions.

banking_knowledge.reason: The unchanged source tasks act on bank customer accounts, cards, disputes, rewards, credit and bank verification through a bank database and knowledge corpus. A company may interact with its bank about authorized company finance, but these individual bank-customer tasks cannot be transplanted into company AP/AR or company records; bank-side provider capability is required to preserve the source tasks.
banking_knowledge.agent_role: Banking customer-service representative using a configurable retrieval pipeline plus discoverable banking tools.

channel_source.domain_evidence: No channel field is declared on these Task records; get_environment assembles bank-specific tools, retrieval policy and KnowledgeUserTools.

banking_knowledge.implementation_status: The original bank-customer service environment is not implemented. A company-side authorized bank inquiry or payment workflow is a separate potential integration, not support for unchanged τ banking tasks.
banking_knowledge.retrieval_context: Environment composes base banking tools with selected retrieval variant and a KnowledgeBase; retrieval/action sequence is part of the bank-agent role.
banking_knowledge.company_workflow_note: Potential for specific company-authorized bank interactions after task-level fit and identity/authority review; the source customer-card/account cases remain provider-side and are not current company assignments.

intake.reason: The 200 source records are callbacks for clinic (80), hotel (71) and automotive service (49). Hotel and automotive customer/partner intake can fit the company’s external workflows; clinic intake needs explicit sensitive-health-data purpose and access handling.
intake.agent_role: Company employee handling an external customer or partner callback and completing the source-defined intake form.

channel_source.domain_evidence: The source environment exposes voice by default and a scaffolded text channel; task scenarios themselves are phone callbacks. Agent-directed voice is the default strategy.

intake.implementation_status: Explicitly deferred by the user. All 200 Intake cases are excluded from the runnable library; no phone-to-email substitution is claimed.

mock.reason: The ten mock rows are upstream development/test fixtures, not business assignments. They must not be presented as runnable user tasks; retain them in the source inventory for audit completeness.
mock.agent_role: Internal team member handling task creation/status or notification and escalating an unsupported request.

channel_source.domain_evidence: MockTools plus MockUserTools; no channel is specified on Task.

mock.implementation_status: Internal fixture inventory only; no user-facing task runner is offered.

retail.reason: The current ERP and customer-support boundary supports company-side product, customer, order, delivery, invoice and customer-service operations. This is a company-adapted native ERP/email projection of the original retail task/evaluator data, not the unchanged τ retail database execution.
retail.agent_role: Retail customer-support agent; verifies one customer, reads that customer’s products/orders/profile, and handles pending-order changes, cancellations, return/exchange requests.

channel_source.domain_evidence: Retail Task records do not carry a channel value. The domain provides RetailTools; the task transcript/channel is selected by the runner.

retail.implementation_status: Native τ retail projection and feedback mapping is implemented for the current company. All 114 source rows remain in the task library; eight have upstream missing-reference issues which are surfaced separately. No task is claimed run or passed.

source_integrity_gaps.reason: source user lookup has zero matches

telecom.reason: The full source has 2,285 telecom-provider tasks. 1,128 reference at least one bill-affecting native write: 1,120 refuel_data calls that add plan-priced charges to a provider draft bill, and eight payment-request/customer-payment cases. The remaining 1,157 do not reference those billing writes and still require carrier subscriber, device, line or network state. The selected billing cases also include technical support actions; they are company-adapted candidates only when source identity is tied to an authorized company carrier account.
telecom.agent_role: Telecom technical-support/customer-service agent; TelecomTools manage the carrier account while TelecomUserTools simulate the customer’s device and payment interaction.

channel_source.domain_evidence: Source domain supports manual/workflow support policies. Telecom environment contains separate customer-device/user tools; no Task channel field.

telecom.implementation_status: Native provider, employee portal and durable email/evaluation adapters implemented; integration-only verification, no live episodes or Viv tests.
telecom.billing_interpretation: Among the 1,128 source rows with bill-affecting reference writes, 1,120 invoke refuel_data and add a plan-priced charge to a provider customer Draft bill; eight invoke send_payment_request and the simulated user make_payment. The latter payment action is propagated only from an actual matching submitted ERP Payment Entry. A provider Draft bill is observed as source evidence and is not treated as a posted ERP invoice, expense or settlement.
telecom.company_workflow_note: All 2,285 pinned source cases use the same external carrier state; 1,128 are classified financial and 1,157 operational. No second company or source reset is created per case.

interpretationNotes: The company-fit assessment separates unchanged source-role requirements from company-adapted external workflows and implementation status; missing adapters are engineering gaps, not reasons to hide eligible workflows.

Airline is an external counterparty, not an excluded domain. The unchanged 50 airline reservation/provider tasks require airline-side operational state; company travel workflows may interact with an airline through an external-provider integration.

The 97 unchanged τ banking tasks operate bank-side customer accounts, cards, credit, disputes and verification. Company-authorized interactions with its bank are separate workflows and must preserve company identity and authority.

Of 2,285 telecom rows, 1,128 reference bill-affecting native writes (1,120 refueling charges and eight bill-payment cases); these fit company-adapted external carrier workflows when linked to an authorized company account. The other 1,157 are carrier device, line or subscriber operations, also presented as company-adapted external service work.

The 200 intake rows cover clinic (80), hotel (71) and automotive service (49) callbacks. Hotel and automotive customer/partner intake can fit this company’s external service workflows; clinic intake needs an explicit sensitive-health-data purpose and access treatment. Source-specific adapters and form flows remain implementation work.
CoffeeBench has nine experiment TOMLs and 21 configured seed runs within one 90-day coffee economy; they are comparisons/configurations, not nine independent business assignments.

E-CommerceBench is a configurable 365-day commerce episode, not a discrete task bank. The current company integration connects the native lifecycle to ERP events and shared background state; its saved benchmark metric panels remain distinct from other benchmarks.

The current experiment library also contains 105 non-coding workplace tasks; other workplace tasks were omitted under prior scope authorization. This count is separate from benchmark source catalogues.

All upstream task rows are preserved in the private source audit artifact. Public compatibility responses expose curated catalogue counts, fit summaries, source revisions and implementation/source-integrity notes; they do not expose task criteria, action arguments or private source records.
